---
title: Flat to Fixed in Fifteen
hook_line: Flat to fixed in fifteen
central_image: a bike wheel spinning on the stand while the customer's coffee is still warm
arc: [a flat tyre at the shop door, the patch goes on while you wait, you ride off before the coffee cools]
title_rationale: the supplied tagline is the shortest line in the lyric and the one listeners should repeat
---

## Notes

The chorus states the brand name and the tagline in the first two lines so a listener who hears only four seconds still gets both. The verse lists what the shop fixes (a thorn, a nail, grit) in plain words and keeps the promise concrete: back out before the coffee cools.
